Market Basket Graph Builder

.. py:module:: graph_recc_sys.graph_dataset

.. py:class:: MarketBasketGraphBuilder(dataset_manager: ~graph_recc_sys.extraction.DatasetManager) :module: graph_recc_sys.graph_dataset

Bases: :py:class:~graph_recc_sys.utils.config.DataClass, :py:class:~torch_geometric.data.in_memory_dataset.InMemoryDataset

Build and manage a PyTorch Geometric heterogeneous graph from market basket, product master data, and customer master data.

This class:

  • reads the input CSV files

  • preprocesses the source tables

  • builds a heterogeneous user-item graph

  • attaches node features for users and products

  • saves the processed graph to disk

  • saves and reloads the mappings between original ids and internal indices

The resulting graph contains:

  • user nodes

  • product nodes

  • edges between users and products representing purchase interactions

  • edge timestamps for possible temporal splits

  • numerical node features for both users and products

:param dataset_manager: Object containing the dataset paths and the target dataset directory. :type dataset_manager: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:class\:\~graph_recc_sys.extraction.DatasetManager``

  :rtype: list[str]

.. py:property:: MarketBasketGraphBuilder.processed_file_names :module: graph_recc_sys.graph_dataset :type: list[str]

  :returns:     Names of files generated during processing.
  :rtype: list[str]

.. py:method:: MarketBasketGraphBuilder.process() :module: graph_recc_sys.graph_dataset

  Build the heterogeneous graph and save it to disk.

  The processing pipeline:
  1. Read the CSV files
  2. Preprocess the input tables
  3. Build the user-item interaction graph
  4. Add product node features
  5. Add customer node features
  6. Convert the graph to an undirected version
  7. Optionally apply `pre_filter` and `pre_transform`
  8. Save the processed graph
  9. Save the id mappings to disk

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:obj\:\`None\``

.. py:property:: MarketBasketGraphBuilder.graph :module: graph_recc_sys.graph_dataset :type: ~torch_geometric.data.hetero_data.HeteroData

  Return the processed heterogeneous graph.

  :returns:     The processed graph stored by the dataset.
  :rtype: HeteroData
